Kai: Quick poll  who wants a roguelike + snack couch night Saturday? I've got a projector and a tiny couch fort.
Rina: In for Hades runs and maybe some Spelunky 2.
Ollie: I'll bring my Steam library and a wired controller. Also chips.
Sam: Can we do a rotation? 45 min runs, then party games. 6pm start?
Kai: 6pm works. I'll DM address. Bring chargers and label stuff.
party-bot: Poll created: 'Saturday night games' Options: Hades, Spelunky 2, Risk of Rain, Party games. Vote with +1.
Rina: +1 Hades
Ollie: +1 Spelunky 2, +1 Risk of Rain
Sam: +1 Party games
Kai: Tally: Hades 1, Spelunky 2 1, Risk of Rain 1, Party games 1. We'll rotate through all.
Rina: Also who can bring floor cushions? My back hates couches.
Ollie: I have two. I'll bring them and extra ethernet cable.
Sam: I'll handle drinks. Kai you handle pizza?
Kai: Yup, pizza at 5:45. Final: Saturday 6pm, small group, comfy chaos. See you! :video_game:
